subject: Re: Pilot incentive structure & acceptance pathway
messages:
From: Dana Park <dana.park@finlytics.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot scope + acceptance gates (MAP) and request for incentives

Karthik —

Appreciate the demo yesterday. Alex and I sketched a short Mutual Action Plan to get an internal pilot approved: 6-week POC, integration with our ingestion pipeline (s3 -> transformer), and acceptance defined as 3 production-like queries per second with 95% percentile latency under 450ms and precision targets on entity extraction.

Two asks from our side to close the procurement:
- Pilot credits to cover peak token usage during the 6-week run (estimate attached).
- A 30-day extension of the trial window in case integration slips and we need more time for acceptance testing.

We are targeting an executive approval meeting on 11/9 and would like an outline of pricing for conversions assuming a staged ramp: month 1 committed baseline, month 2-3 2x ramp, month 4 steady-state. Can you send a proposed MAP with milestone-linked pricing/discounts?

Thanks,
Dana Park
Head of ML Products
FinLytics

Attachments: FinLytics-MAP-timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-pilot-credit-breakdown.csv (csv)

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: Dana Park <dana.park@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot scope + acceptance gates (MAP) and request for incentives

Dana —

Thanks for the clear acceptance criteria — that helps a lot. We can:

1) Issue a one-off pilot credit package that covers estimated peak token usage (will include a buffer).
2) Approve a trial extension up to 30 days on a case-by-case basis; we can pre-authorize that for FinLytics given the integration scope.

I'll propose a MAP that includes milestone checkpoints at week 2 (ingest/validation), week 4 (throughput/latency), and week 6 (acceptance). For commercial terms, we typically offer a staged conversion discount tied to commit size: a 10% introductory discount on a 6- or 12-month committed baseline, and a 5% additional discount for a proven ramp to 2x within 90 days. I'll pull a worked example and SOW draft — looping Marissa to shape the credit/incentive numbers.

Proposed next step: I’ll send the draft MAP + SOW by EOD Thursday and we can hop on a quick sync with Alex to walk through. Does 10am PT on Friday work?

— Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-pilot-credit-breakdown.csv (attached)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: FinLytics MAP — credit sizing & pricing structure

Karthik —

Looking at their attachment, the estimated token burn is moderate but concentrated in the last two weeks (acceptance load test). Recommend we structure pilot credits as:
- 60% applied as up-front credit for integration/validation (week 1-3)
- 40% reserved for load-testing and acceptance (released on passing week-4 throughput test)

For conversion pricing, propose the following staged offer to present to the customer (keeps it simple at exec review):
- Month 1: committed baseline at $X / month (anchor price)
- Months 2-3: 2x ramp allowance with 7% discount off list for the ramp volume
- Month 4 onwards: steady-state with volume-tiered discounts (10% at $Y commit, 15% at $Z commit)

I’ll prepare a short one-pager to include in the MAP and a redline of the SOW. Sergio — can you confirm SLA language and whether we can guarantee the 450ms p95 target under Dedicated capacity if they commit?

-Marissa
Head of Commercials, Redwood Inference

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: FinLytics MAP — credit sizing & pricing structure

Marissa / Karthik —

We can guarantee the 450ms p95 on Dedicated with the following caveats captured in the MAP:
- Customer to use our recommended model variant (quantized) and adhere to the input token length limits in the first 4 weeks.
- Production traffic must be routed to Dedicated pool with the reserved commit.
- If they remain on hosted multi-tenant during the pilot, we can offer a 2-tier SLA (best-effort + fallback) but cannot guarantee p95.

I’m fine with the credit split. Suggest we add a clause that remaining reserved credits convert to a one-time invoice credit toward the committed baseline if they convert within 60 days of acceptance. That helps show fairness and commercial alignment.

-Sergio
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: Dana Park <dana.park@finlytics.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP + SOW (draft) and proposed pilot credits — FinLytics

Dana / Alex —

Attached is a draft MAP and SOW that reflects what we discussed. Highlights:
- Pilot credits: $12,000 applied as 60/40 split (60% upfront, 40% held for acceptance load test).
- Trial extension: authorized up to 30 days if integration dates slip, to be requested before the scheduled week-6 acceptance test.
- Conversion playbook: 6-month baseline commit option (anchor) with a 10% introductory discount, and an escalation discount of 5% if they hit 2x in months 2-3.
- SLA: 450ms p95 guarantee on Dedicated once the commit is active and routing is configured (see section 4.2).

Next steps: please review and tell us any redlines. If agreeable, we’ll issue a DocuSign for the SOW and a separate pilot credit agreement. Can we target sign-off by 11/9 to align with your exec meeting?

Thanks — happy to walk through on Friday 10am PT.

— Karthik

Attachments: FinLytics-MAP-timeline.xlsx, FinLytics-SOW-v2.pdf, redwood-pilot-credit-breakdown.csv

[Quoted text — previous message from Marissa Cole and Sergio Alvarez omitted for brevity]

From: Dana Park <dana.park@finlytics.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + SOW (draft) and proposed pilot credits — FinLytics

Karthik / team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround — the draft looks reasonable. A couple of small asks before exec review:
- Can the upfront credit be increased by 10% to cover unforeseen ingestion rework? (We can commit to sharing any increased consumption data.)
- Add an optional clause that leftover pilot credits can offset the first invoice month if we sign within 45 days of acceptance (instead of 60).

If you can send those two edits, I’ll include the updated MAP in the exec packet and we should be able to sign the SOW the week of 11/9. Please attach a DocuSign link when ready.

Dana

Attachment: exec-packet-outline.pdf (for internal reference)
